result.summary: Several visual layout and truncation issues are present: restaurant names and images are cut off, category chips overflow, and content cards appear clipped at the edges.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section, and its card image is partially clipped on the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card widths and text wrapping/ellipsis accommodate full restaurant names, or allow horizontal scroll with fully visible cards and complete labels.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is heavily cropped—only the top portion of the pizza image is visible, cutting off most of the content.
issues.suggestion: Give the popular/promo cards adequate height so the full image and any associated text remain visible above the tab bar.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflow horizontally with a partial chip visible on the right, without clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible horizontal scroll indicator or ensure chips fit/wrap consistently; avoid cutting chips mid-element.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under Green Bowl Poké shows '€0.90 delivery' which may be incomplete or oddly formatted compared to others.
issues.suggestion: Standardize delivery fee labeling (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') and ensure full strings are not truncated.

issues.description: Profile avatar in the top right is an empty light circle with only a tiny red dot, looking unfinished or broken.
issues.suggestion: Show a proper user avatar, initials, or a clear icon so the control doesn't appear empty/broken.
